title: What We Learned Trying to Make SBTG Work

rows.method: Ridge VAR, Granger, sparse transition, SINDy
rows.implementation: Least squares, ridge regularization, thresholding or sparse libraries on lagged histories
rows.learned_quantity: Conditional mean or reduced-form transition support
rows.key_result: Best or tied for finite-time conditional means; mandatory baseline

rows.implementation: Penalized conditional Gaussian mean and log-variance model
rows.learned_quantity: Normalized conditional law with mean and dispersion fields
rows.key_result: Best matched mean-field and dispersion-field recovery

rows.implementation: Linear conditional location and scale under Student-t likelihood
rows.key_result: Strong cheap alternative on heavy-tailed data; weak physical dispersion readout in matched panel

rows.implementation: Factorized conditional mixture likelihood; K=3 in the matched-tail panel and K=4 in later cross-model work
rows.learned_quantity: Multimodal conditional density and sample generator
rows.key_result: Best matched-tail prediction, but physical tail derivative remained wrong
rows.verdict: Use for predictive shape, not mechanism derivative

rows.implementation: Closed-form quadratic conditional score with Hyvarinen objective and analytic Gaussian reconstruction
rows.learned_quantity: Conditional response score and fitted mean/log-variance sensitivities
rows.key_result: Recovered matched channels in some settings but lost to Gaussian NLL

rows.implementation: Gaussian-corrupted response-score regression over a denoising-noise ladder
rows.learned_quantity: Score of a corrupted conditional law
rows.key_result: Denoising regularized some fits but did not automatically recover the clean law or physical mechanism
rows.verdict: Useful regularizer, not a universal estimator

rows.implementation: Nonlinear conditional Gaussian network trained by likelihood or denoising score matching
rows.learned_quantity: Differentiable Gaussian law and derivative readouts
rows.key_result: Neural DSM modestly improved its within-architecture dispersion derivative, but both variants lost to simple Gaussian NLL
rows.verdict: Capacity did not solve estimand mismatch

rows.implementation: Joint-state denoising score model on consecutive standardized states; cross-moments or mixed response-score derivatives used as edge statistics
rows.learned_quantity: Joint score and reduced-form localization statistic
rows.key_result: Moderate mean-like localization, weak dispersion localization, little mechanism specificity

rows.implementation: Differentiate a fitted normalized density or response score with respect to a history direction
rows.key_result: Optimization converged, but covariance/skew derivative-readiness gates failed

rows.method: Signed classifier, finite density ratio, Riesz/ORTH
rows.implementation: Compare two nearby supported history laws by balanced classification, direct ratios, or cross-fitted feature moments
rows.learned_quantity: Finite signed contrast or projection onto declared response features
rows.key_result: Worked for location and low-rank mixture; initial covariance/skew adapters failed; later typed/ORTH repairs recovered restricted covariance geometry
rows.verdict: Promising when support and target channel are explicit

rows.implementation: Sequential likelihood over release, concentration, receptor occupancy and calcium emissions, with explicit knockout operations
rows.learned_quantity: Represented latent mechanism and intervention-like operations
rows.key_result: Higher claim ceiling but weak latent alignment, clearance, and controlled knockout recovery

rows.implementation: Heteroskedastic endpoint model plus Brownian-reference path bridge
rows.key_result: Useful path baseline; sensitivity to reference diffusion dominated and did not identify neuromodulation

rows.implementation: Calibrated mean, conditional-rule, dispersion, tail, MMD, energy and segmentation scans
rows.learned_quantity: Whether and where a declared channel changes
rows.key_result: Matched mean and tail probes succeeded; variance detector was broad and non-specific

rows.method: Noise ladder, aggregation, gating, shrinkage, functional target, frozen features
rows.implementation: Reliability averaging, ganglion pooling, PC1 gating, James-Stein shrinkage, functional-atlas comparison and frozen-trunk analytic heads
rows.learned_quantity: More stable or biologically aligned score-derived summaries
rows.key_result: Some reproducibility gains, but no robust distributional-specific connectome or kinetics result
rows.verdict: Useful diagnostics; mechanistic claim remained negative

rows.implementation: Generate natural prefixes and futures once, then self-normalize low/high compatibility potentials
rows.learned_quantity: Model-relative future law under compatible low/high source histories
rows.key_result: Fast and paired, but rare queries can collapse weights

rows.implementation: Temper the source/anchor potential through the repair prefix with ESS-adaptive resampling, then release particles and roll forward unchanged dynamics
rows.learned_quantity: Same repaired-path law with lower finite-particle error
rows.key_result: Best tested finite-particle estimator; cannot repair model misspecification or unsupported queries
rows.verdict: Current estimator of choice with diagnostics

source.label: Matched-tail conditional-law benchmark
filters: Matched-tail DGP; common splits, horizons and seeds; lower is better

metricDefinitions.label: Held-out NLL
metricDefinitions.definition: Average negative log likelihood on held-out outcomes under a normalized predictive law; lower is better.

metricDefinitions.label: Tail-probability RMSE
metricDefinitions.definition: Root mean squared error of predicted tail probability against the known synthetic conditional law; lower is better.

source.label: Matched physical-field recovery panel
filters: Five mechanisms; five fresh DGP seeds 8-12; 250/250 cases completed; lower is better

metricDefinitions.label: nISE
metricDefinitions.definition: Normalized integrated squared error against the known synthetic field. A zero-field prediction has baseline 1.0; lower is better.

rows.interpretation: All emit the zero gated field

source.label: Synthetic synaptic-gating field benchmark
filters: Lower is better; 1.0 is the zero-field baseline; rows with ranges show the best end of the reported range

metricDefinitions.label: Synaptic-gating nISE
metricDefinitions.definition: Normalized integrated squared error of the total modulator-gated response field against known synthetic truth.

source.label: Ten-seed finite central contrast panel
filters: Clean law; central contrast delta=0.1; ten adapter/evaluation seeds 5004-5013; 76,760 metric rows

metricDefinitions.label: Witness NRMSE
metricDefinitions.definition: Normalized root mean squared error of the learned finite signed witness. The zero-witness baseline is approximately 1; lower is better.

metricDefinitions.definition: Difference in biological correspondence used in the original lag analysis; reported only to show attenuation across increasingly valid analyses.
